name: hypermemory
description: Always-on, relationship-aware memory for ChatGPT and Codex with OAuth MCP access, delegated persistence, and token telemetry.

interface.shortDescription: Durable memory for every ChatGPT and Codex turn
interface.longDescription: Recall relevant context during work, then process durable memories after the answer is complete. Codex completion hooks launch a writer only for candidate memories; timeline and exact token reporting run separately without a model.
defaultPrompt: Recall the context for this work and keep memory current.
